title: Internal reviewer ablation
question: Does adding an internal reviewer to a setup change accepted quality, and does it change it the same way for a solo session as for a graph?
establishes: The marginal contribution of an internal reviewer within each coordination shape. The external evaluator is unchanged and stays separate from the internal reviewer.

environment.notes: Local operator machine, offline. Node 22+ and Git only; no provider calls are made by the bench. Record the actual machine, tool versions and network posture before starting.

controls.internal_reviewer: ablated: identical reviewer present in two arms, absent in the other two
